top_signals.title: Firmus Stock Overhang Said to Make Some Investors Wary on IPO
top_signals.summary: Some potential investors are turning more cautious on the blockbuster initial public offering of data center firm Firmus Grid Ltd. as they worry about existing shareholders potentially flooding the market soon after the company’s debut, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Better Markets says CFTC is ‘wrong agency’ to regulate retail crypto
top_signals.summary: Better Markets said the CFTC’s proposed framework to bring certain cryptocurrency transactions and exchanges under its oversight will leave investors less protected than under the SEC.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
